product.name: California Olive Ranch 100% California Extra Virgin Olive Oil 16.9 fl oz
product.description: Certified extra virgin olive oil pressed entirely from olives grown in California's Sacramento Valley and milled at California Olive Ranch's Artois, CA facility — an all-domestic supply chain with no export, freight, or import legs. This is the deliberate contrast to the brand's separate 'Global Blend' line, which explicitly blends imported olive oils with California oil; the '100% California' line does not.

productMaterials.originNote: Grown on California Olive Ranch's own ranches and by contract grower partners around Oroville, Artois, and Corning in Northern California.

events.evidenceSummary: The brand's own product page states the oil is 'Cold Pressed and sourced from our farms and grower partners here in California,' and KQED's harvest feature places the growing operations in the towns of Oroville, Artois, and Corning, about 60 miles north of Sacramento. Open Food Facts independently records origins as United States. This line is the all-domestic counterpart to the brand's imported 'Global Blend'.

Milling and bottling happen at California Olive Ranch's mill in Artois (Glenn County), CA. KQED's on-site harvest report describes olives traveling about 35 minutes from orchard to the mill and being pressed within hours; a Farm Progress trade-press article on the Artois mill corroborates but could not be fetched for a verbatim excerpt (flagged needs-verification).

The bottle is stocked as a standard shelf item by national grocery retailers — Target lists this exact 16.9 fl oz item in stock with shipping and store pickup — which implies nationwide grocery distribution out of the brand's California operations. No public distributor or warehouse records identify the specific distribution network.
events.inferenceBasis: National retail availability (verifiable Target.com listing for this exact UPC/size) implies US-wide grocery distribution; the specific distributors and DC locations are not publicly documented.
